tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Convert text to spoken audio with a VoiceHue voice. Returns the audio (MP3 by default, or WAV) and a one-line summary with the voice, number of characters and duration. Up to 1,200 characters per call. Use list_voices first to get a valid voice id.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the public VoiceHue voices a key can use: id, name, language and gender. Pass a voice id to text_to_speech.
